text.p: Rural Cellular Corp said Friday it completed acquisition of the Maine wireless telephone operations of Unity Cellular Systems Inc and some cellular and microwave licenses from InterCel Inc.
Completion of the transactions followed regulatory approvals, the company said in a statement.

Unity, which operates under the name Unicel, will be operated as MRCC Inc, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Rural Cellular. The Unity assets and related licenses were acquired for about $77 million or $175 per POP.

In a related development, Rural Cellular also said it acquired 100 percent ownership of Maine RSA 2 by purchasing the 49 percent interest held by an affiliate of Bell Atlantic NYNEX Mobile Inc. for $105 per POP, resulting in a blended purchase price for the Maine properties of about $165 per POP.
Rural Cellular said Thursday it had secured financing for the acquisition through a $140 million credit facility.
Unicel's service area extends from Maine's central coastline to the northeastern part of the state.
In addition to Maine, Rural Cellular provides wireless telecommunications services in northern Minnesota and parts of western Wisconsin and eastern North Dakota.
